$comment: SEO-08: Feasly performance budgets. Single source of truth for the Lighthouse CI gate (.github/workflows/lighthouse.yml), the local budget check (apps/web/tools/check-perf-budgets.mjs), and the Angular build budgets (apps/web/angular.json).

auditUrls.$comment: Generated deterministically by apps/web/tools/perf-audit-urls.mjs from prerender-routes.txt: root + marketing pages + communities index + first 3 community pages alphabetically.

buyback.rule: BUY-BACK RULE (SEO-08 AC4): any PR that grows initial JS by more than 5 KB (gzipped) versus the baseline below must note the tradeoff in the PR description (what got slower, why it is worth it). This is a bot comment, not a hard fail — softer than the Lighthouse gate. If the growth is accepted, update baselineJsInitialGzipKb to the new measured value in the same PR so the next PR is measured against reality.
